text.p: These are the leading stories in the Angolan press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- United Nations Secretary General Boutros Boutros Ghali said in a report on the Angolan peace process that delays by the former rebel Unita movement in the implementation of the Lusaka Protocol were no longer acceptable. The Security Council is to review its peackeeping mandate in Angola on October 11.

- Six thousand landmines were discovered in the first half of this year by two demining companies in Angola's Malange and Bie provinces, the National Institute for the Removal of Explosive Devices (INAROE) said.
